zh_CN: 背部槽没有可用容器。装备背包后才能存放物品。
en: No usable container is equipped on the back slot. Equip a bag to store items.

zh_CN: 选择格子中的物品或装备槽以查看详情。
en: Select an item in the grid or an equipment slot to inspect it.

zh_CN: 点击选择，再次点击取消；长按拖动，拖动时按 R 旋转。
en: Select an item to equip, use, or drop it; drag to move and press R to rotate.

zh_CN: 再次点击取消选择；长按物品后拖动，按 R 旋转。
en: Drag the item to move it; press R while dragging to rotate.

zh_CN: 选择物品后才能选择目标槽位。
en: Select an item before choosing an equipment slot.
Select an item before equipping it.
Select an item before using it.
Select an item before dropping it.

zh_CN: 此物品没有可用的装备槽位，不能装备。
en: This item has no compatible equipment slot and cannot be equipped.

zh_CN: 此物品没有可用的使用动作。
en: This item has no available use action.

zh_CN: 选择要装备到的目标槽位。
en: Choose the equipment slot for this item.

zh_CN: 将物品装备到所选槽位。
en: Equip the item in the selected slot.

zh_CN: 将所选物品丢到当前世界。
en: Drop the selected item into the current world.
You are already at the outermost container.

zh_CN: 点击选择，再次点击取消；长按并拖入背包可卸下。
en: Select an equipped item; place it in the grid to stow it.
